editorial.blurb: Carnitas Uruapan delivers authentic Mexican flavors with generous portions and vibrant ambiance that transport you straight to Michoacán.
editorial.insiderTip: You can seat yourself—don't wait at the counter. Order carnitas and specify which part of the pig you'd like, and don't skip the complimentary chicharrones with salsa selection.

topDishes.note: Loaded with delicious carnitas; you can specify which cut of pig you want
